1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously encoded pictures of the sequence__.

7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on statistical analysis of mode selection patterns__.

8. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the coding information includes mode selection frequency data collected during encoding of the previously coded pictures__.

9. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures __using a video encoder__, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960), __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously encoded pictures of the sequence__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence (550, 960) __based on statistical analysis of mode selection patterns__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence (940, 960), __wherein the coding information includes mode selection frequency data collected during encoding of the previously coded pictures__.

17. (Currently Amended) An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously decoded pictures of the sequence__.

23. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on statistical analysis of mode selection patterns__.

24. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the coding information includes mode selection frequency data collected during decoding of the previously coded pictures__.

25. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures __using a video decoder__, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously decoded pictures of the sequence__.

31. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on statistical analysis of mode selection patterns__.

32. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the coding information includes mode selection frequency data collected during decoding of the previously coded pictures__.

33. (Currently Amended) A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and wherein the mode mapping information comprises a reordering of available modes based on frequency of mode usage in previously encoded pictures of the sequence__.
